steps.en: Install the SDK with the Hugging Face runtime extra
steps.zh: 安装 SDK，带上 HF 运行时 extra

steps.en: Send a note to the analyzer, naming a task model
steps.zh: 把笔记交给分析器，指定任务模型

steps.en: Fetches the matching checkpoint from the catalog into local cache
steps.zh: 从模型目录把对应检查点拉进本地缓存

steps.en: Labels spans on your hardware and returns entities with confidence
steps.zh: 在你的机器上标注片段，返回带置信度的实体

steps.en: Ask for the shareable copy with a redaction method
steps.zh: 选定脱敏方法，索要可外发副本

steps.en: Masks PII spans locally and returns the de-identified text
steps.zh: 在本地遮盖 PII 片段，返回脱敏文本

value.en: One clinical note becomes typed entities plus a shareable redacted copy on hardware you control, with nothing sent to a cloud API
value.zh: 一份临床笔记在你自己的机器上变成带类型实体和可外发的脱敏副本，任何数据都不经过云端 API

sources: README.md: 30-second example (from openmed import analyze_text, model_name="disease_detection_superclinical", result.entities)
